result:
If I could change the world in one way, I'd make high-quality education — focused on critical thinking, civic literacy, practical skills, and empathy — truly universal and lifelong.

Why: broad, equitable education reduces poverty, improves health, strengthens democracies, lowers conflict, and helps people adapt to technological and environmental change. Teaching people how to think, evaluate information, and understand others multiplies the benefits across nearly every social and economic problem.
